title: Monthly Rate Billing and the Community Fee for Memory Care
content:
The Memory Care Residency Agreement is billed by the calendar month, in advance, at the all-inclusive monthly rate of the tier billed, and a one-time community fee may apply at move-in.

## Billing practice

1. **Monthly rate.** The all-inclusive monthly rate of the tier billed is charged in advance on the tier's billing day for the whole calendar month. The monthly rate accrues from the move-in date.
2. **Prorated months.** The move-in month, the month of a program, suite or rate change and the month fees end are prorated by actual days in the month. The days billed are counted inclusive of both ends of the span, and the prorated amount is the monthly rate multiplied by the days billed and divided by the days in that calendar month, rounded once to the cent, half up.
3. **Community fee.** The community fee is charged once, at move-in, at the tier's community fee, except that no community fee is charged where the tier waives it for an internal transfer and the admission source is a Larkspur independent living residency or a Larkspur assisted living residency.
4. **When charges may be posted.** Monthly rate and community fee charges may be posted only while the residency is in active, on leave or notice given status, as shown on the residency record.

## Community fee: decision table

| Tier waives the fee for an internal transfer | Admission source | Community fee at move-in |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Larkspur independent living residency | None |
| Yes | Larkspur assisted living residency | None |
| Yes | Any other source | Charged once at the tier's community fee |
| No | Any source | Charged once at the tier's community fee |

## Proration: worked figure (hypothetical rate)

A resident moves in on 12 September at a hypothetical monthly rate of 7200.00. September has 30 days; the span 12 to 30 September, counted inclusive of both ends, is 19 days. The move-in month's charge is 7200.00 multiplied by 19 and divided by 30, which is 4560.00. From 1 October the full monthly rate is charged in advance.

A second illustration with a remainder: at a hypothetical 7000.00, a span of 10 days in a 31-day month is 7000.00 multiplied by 10 and divided by 31, which is 2258.0645..., charged as 2258.06 - the rounding is applied once, to the final amount.

## Posting status

| Residency status | Monthly rate or community fee may be posted |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| On leave | Yes |
| Notice given | Yes |
| Pending admission, vacated, closed or cancelled | No |

The last row follows from the closed list in clause 4; a residency still pending admission is charged nothing until move-in.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a resident on a hospital leave keep being billed the monthly rate?** Yes; on leave is one of the statuses in which the monthly rate is posted.

**How many days are billed for a move-in on the last day of a 31-day month?** One day - the span runs from that day to that day, inclusive of both ends.
